name: jev-mode
description: Cut agent token use by routing bulk semantic judgments to TypeSafe Jev.

interface.shortDescription: Cut token use on bulk semantic judgments.
interface.longDescription: Jev Mode teaches an agent when and how to offload bulk bounded semantic judgments - classifying, routing, triaging, ranking, relevance filtering - to TypeSafe Jev, and points it at the jev-mode batch helper. Install the CLI with pip install jev-mode and set TYPESAFE_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Is this list better handled by Jev?
Triage these items through Jev and show me the counts.
